findings: All ten artifacts reproduce byte-for-byte through public Harness; 19 public core tests passed, two unchanged adversarial tests remained ignored, and the ten-arm warm suite completed in 0.46 seconds.

The original recent-route diagnostic was invalid for its named write/read boundary: its presumed fresh output was unintended dynamic topology and received zero return updates at ratios 1, 2, 4, and 8.
The original coalition diagnostic was invalid for lineage preservation: one proposed member had no executable consequential path before shared-origin selection.

Corrected neutral fixtures used existing candidate physics to continue a recent successful route through ratio 8 with later release and to recall both actually trained cooperating members under one shared origin.
The original surface zero-update failure was a distance-zero no-path fixture; distance one formed the action path, opened one finite return, and delivered two updates.

One action return retained both useful surface origins once in either order while rejecting duplicate and unrelated origins and expiring naturally, but neither surface expressed the reverse motor action.
Finite return, indexed active aging, and origin sparsity retained their exact predicates under neutral composition.

The one-joint and acoustic four-step preflights produced zero motion; the attempted full one-joint run exceeded the development budget under topology growth, so later body compositions remained inconclusive.
residual_uncertainty: The corrected recent-route and cooperating-pair positives are observations inside a falsified hybrid arm and require standalone frozen replication before becoming positive campaign claims.
Action-to-surface association has not been shown sufficient for reverse surface-to-action execution.
The first zero-movement transition and the source of structural path-formation growth remain unlocalized.
No candidate mechanism was adopted into default physics, and no one-joint, binocular-hand, vocal-auditory, full-body, Academy, ARC, or authority capability advanced.
